name: What is the process for replacing kitchen countertops?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for replacing kitchen countertops?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our countertop replacement process begins with a consultation and measurement appointment at your home. We then assist you in selecting the best material and style. After selection, we proceed with fabrication of your chosen material. Finally, our team handles the removal of your old countertops and the professional installation of the new ones, ensuring a precise fit and finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, material selection, fabrication, old countertop removal, and new countertop installation.
